items.reason: A gentle cleanser keeps oily, sensitive-looking skin clean without stripping it.
A milder 10% glycolic toner can help smooth the look of uneven texture with less intensity than a 30% peel.
A ceramide moisturizer supports a comfortable, balanced look and cushions skin between exfoliating nights.
A mineral SPF 50 is gentle on sensitive-looking skin and is needed daily alongside exfoliating acids.

response.routine_note: I've left out the 30% peel because it is a very high strength for Oily & Sensitive skin that isn't already using acids, and I've swapped in a gentler glycolic toner to use one night a week at first, building up slowly if skin stays comfortable. Use the cleanser and moisturizer morning and night, apply the SPF every morning, and if texture or sensitivity worries you, a dermatologist is the best person to ask.
